training_validity: 2000 actual finite parameter-changing optimizer updates per class; finite changed checkpoint; nonzero projection
task_support: for both short and pinhole, repaired mean normalized pair gap and fraction above real q95 must each be lower than pretrained no-adaptation
real_manifold_sanity: fraction above real q95 must remain below 1.0 for both classes
fidelity: relative to pretrained no-adaptation, overall LPIPS must not increase and overall edge cosine must not decrease
feasible_rule: all training, task, manifold, and fidelity gates pass
mixed_rule: training passes and at least one of task or fidelity passes, but not all feasibility gates pass
not_feasible_rule: training passes but neither task nor fidelity passes
